sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_STATIC contract: ship-owned frameProfileType is present with its canonical range; structural-member orientation, location, capacity alternatives, and load-case relationship use the authoritative owners; applicability is restricted to longitudinal side-structure members; non-applicable members remain unconstrained; exactly one capacity representation is required for applicable members; decimal values and the declared kN units are enforced; and each represented demand is compared against only the selected capacity with demand > capacity as the failure condition. Universal member and load-case semantics are preserved, and no invented vocabulary terms or named shape IRIs remain.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Semantic validator feedback: Repair the graph before freezing: remove the invented named shape IRIs in the canonical vocabulary namespace (use blank-node SHACL shapes or otherwise registered shape identifiers). Encode the COMPLETE dependency relationship frameProfileType on its authoritative required owner ship, using the canonical nltl:frameProfileType path and its declared range. Attach the plasticStrength/midspanPlasticCollapseLoad alternative constraint to each structuralMember; the current StructuralMemberResultShape is unattached, and its maxCount-only branches allow both quantities to be absent. Preserve the universal no-existence semantics for members and load cases. Correct the comparison so a represented load-case demand fails when it exceeds the selected available plastic-strength or midspan-collapse-load alternative; the current AND of two EXISTS branches accidentally passes when only one alternative is present. Ensure the alternative cannot pass without branch-selection evidence and retain the authoritative member owners, xsd:decimal values, and kN units for the two strength quantities.

Repair the applicability logic: do not add an invented bottomStructureLocation alternative or make the member shape reject longitudinal members at other locations. The constraint applies only when longitudinalFrameOrientation=true and structuralLocation=sideStructureLocation; non-longitudinal or non-side members must remain unconstrained apart from the supplied applicability inputs. Encode the plasticStrength versus midspanPlasticCollapseLoad choice as an explicit, non-conjunctive branch-selection alternative (prefer exactly one selected representation, or otherwise prevent both branches from being treated as simultaneously mandatory), with each selected branch requiring minCount 1. Ensure the load-case comparison uses only the selected capacity representation: a demand fails iff it exceeds that selected value, and must not fail merely because an unselected alternative is lower. Preserve the ship-owned frameProfileType relationship, structuralMember-owned orientation/location/capacity properties, loadCase-owned demand, decimal datatypes, kN units, and universal no-existence semantics for members and load cases.

Do not freeze: preserve the ship-owned frameProfileType relationship, structuralMember-owned orientation/location/capacity properties, loadCase-owned decimal demand, kN units, universal no-existence semantics, and the explicit non-conjunctive capacity alternative. The applicability branch is still inverted: I2_034_NonApplicableLocationShape currently selects longitudinal members at sideStructureLocation, so an applicable member can satisfy sh:or without either capacity or comparison. Replace it with a branch that passes only when NOT(longitudinalFrameOrientation=true AND structuralLocation=sideStructureLocation), while leaving non-longitudinal and non-side members otherwise unconstrained. Keep both capacity branches restricted to true plus sideStructureLocation, require exactly one selected capacity with minCount 1 and exclude the other, and compare every represented load-case demand against only that selected capacity using demand > capacity as the failure condition. Also replace the invented named generated shape identifiers with blank-node SHACL shapes or registered shape identifiers as required by the prior feedback.

The candidate faithfully encodes the COMPLETE DIRECT_STATIC contract: ship-owned frameProfileType is present with its canonical range; structural-member orientation, location, capacity alternatives, and load-case relationship use the authoritative owners; applicability is restricted to longitudinal side-structure members; non-applicable members remain unconstrained; exactly one capacity representation is required for applicable members; decimal values and the declared kN units are enforced; and each represented demand is compared against only the selected capacity with demand > capacity as the failure condition. Universal member and load-case semantics are preserved, and no invented vocabulary terms or named shape IRIs remain.
